build_transporter_model: build a Transporter module with an Encoder, KeyPointer, and Decoder to reconstruct image_b from image_a
create_encoder_module: create an Encoder module with configurable filters, kernel sizes, and normalization to extract image features
create_decoder_module: create a Decoder module with configurable initial filters and output size to reconstruct images from features
create_keypointer_module: create a KeyPointer module with a keypoint encoder to extract Gaussian keypoint heatmaps from images
compute_reconstruction_loss: compute the L1 or L2 reconstruction loss between a target image and a predicted image
